description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 全屏播放视频时也能截图了：系统自带的“媒体播放器”等商店应用全屏时，以前截图框被压在视频下面看不见，按 Esc 也只会让播放器退出全屏、截图却退不出来；现在按截图键，截图框照常盖上来，截的就是全屏画面，Esc 正常退出；复制、保存或取消后，播放器自动回到全屏（贴图、识别文字、录屏后保持窗口模式，方便看到结果）。万一系统不让切换，会结束这次截图并弹通知说明原因。权限不变。
notes.en: Screenshots over a full-screen video: when Windows' Media Player or another Store app was in full screen, the capture overlay stayed hidden under the video and Esc only took the player out of full screen, leaving the capture stuck. Now the capture key brings the overlay over it with the full-screen picture, and Esc works; after copying, saving or cancelling, the player goes back into full screen (after a pin, read text or a recording it stays in a window so the result can be seen). If Windows refuses the switch, the capture ends with a notification saying why. Permissions unchanged.
